title: The CIA showed Elizondo MRIs of UAP witnesses with caudate putamen differences

tellings.quote: from my point of view when I got involved the CIA came to my office and then they showed me MRIs of some of these people and most of those people had interactions with UFOs

plain: The CIA is said to have shown MRI brain scans of people who had encountered UFOs, and the scans showed differences in the caudate putamen, a structure deep in the brain. The scientist Garry Nolan says on a documentary about the former Pentagon official Lue Elizondo that when he got involved, "the CIA came to my office and then they showed me MRIs of some of these people," most of whom "had interactions with UFOs." If true, it would mean these encounters leave a physical mark in the brain, and that the CIA was quietly studying it.
